visual_en: A tall robotic figure wearing a dark brown brass mask with a single glowing golden eye. The character wears a heavy, layered dark brown leather pirate coat adorned with lavish golden ornaments and a flowing golden-edged cape. On its back, an oversized wooden treasure chest bag is strapped, decorated with small golden coins. The character holds a massive, heavy anchor-shaped greatsword made of dark iron and gold. The boots are heavy metallic straw-style boots with dangling golden chains. A strong, radiant golden aura flows from the joints, leaving a trail of golden crescent moon particles.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing tall and imposing, leaning heavily on a massive anchor sword with a wide, confident stance.
vfx_en: A few golden crescent slashes flying forward and small amber sparks
motion_en: Heavy anchor slam with golden shockwaves

Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
